text:
Priya S: Heads up — we're pushing a small ratecard patch to clean up SKU mappings and introduce a 90d grace window for existing commits. Effective 2026-04-01.
Evan T: can you summarise what "grace window" covers? customers on active commits get old pricing for 90 days?
Lena K: Yep. grace window = existing committed customers keep v2025 pricing + current discounts for 90d. After that they get mapped to nearest new tier. No retro credits.
Tom R: For POCs, can we still apply a temporary promo? We have a healthcare POC asking for 50% off for 3 months.
Priya S: POCs should go through DealDesk for exceptions. This patch includes a POC SKU and a rule that POC discounts can't stack with commit credits.
DealDesk:@Tom R please submit the form (link: https://redwood.internal/dealdesk/requests) w/ customer name, ARR equivalent, and expected start/end. We'll triage same day.
Tom R: lodged request — #DD-4432. Tagging finance because the POC is refundable credit vs prepaid ask.
Finance Ops: For refundable credits, we flag them as liability; prefer prepaid credits for non-refundable. Will evaluate on a case-by-case.
DealDeskBot: ratecard_v2026_patch.pdf uploaded to /shared/sales/ratecards (sha256: abc123...). Decision matrix attached.
Evan T: Any impacts to APAC pricing/region surcharges?
Priya S: No base price changes in APAC; small regional surcharge adjustments handled by the MR. Will note in release notes.
Lena K: Rollout plan: internal announcement today, enable doc in sales portal, 2-week TTL for quoting UI to accept old SKUs, then auto-map.
Tom R: ok, thanks. One quick: grandfathering for customers with multi-year commits? They keep current rate for full term, right?
DealDesk: Yes multi-year committed customers are locked to contractually committed rate until renewal. Exceptions require legal/finance sign-off.
Priya S: Great — I'll send the final email and update the internal playbook. Ping me if you need wording for customer comms. :thumbsup:
